report.raw: {"schema_version":"m0-report-v2","assessment_status":"completed","conclusion":"supported","summary":"Checkout's elevated errors in the last 5 minutes (2026-11-03T18:09:44Z–18:14:44Z) are real and localized: checkout produced ~10 ERROR spans in that bucket while every one of the 11 preceding 5-minute buckets in the prior hour showed 0. The failures are PlaceOrder calls that fail after checkout's client call to oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge; the payment service's own server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge threw 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' at /usr/src/app/charge.js:37 and returned gRPC code 2/Unknown, which checkout surfaced as code 13 INTERNAL 'failed to charge card'. Payment's Charge error rate went from 0 in all prior hourly buckets to ~5 error spans of ~7.5 Charge spans in the window. Cart, product-catalog, currency, shipping and email show no error spans of their own and no ERROR-status series, and no service shows elevated p95 latency versus a comparable baseline window (checkout 45.09 ms now vs 47.6 ms baseline; payment 4.7 vs 5.0; all dependencies at or below baseline). Frontend /api/checkout shows 5 error spans per 5 minutes in the same window, consistent with the checkout failures propagating outward. incident.acceptance_step: eval-suite development baseline (not an acceptance step)

stimulus.question: Checkout is reported to show elevated errors in the OTel Demo. Using the authorized metrics range query and trace search for the last 5 minutes, determine whether checkout and its dependency calls (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) show failures or elevated latency, cite trace ids, and return a json investigation report.

claims.text: Checkout error spans appeared only in the final 5-minute bucket: sum by (service_name,status_code) increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="checkout"}[300s]) was 0 for STATUS_CODE_ERROR at every step from 17:19:44Z through 18:09:44Z and 10.0 at 18:14:44Z (bucket 18:09:44Z–18:14:44Z), while STATUS_CODE_UNSET spans were 67–173 per bucket throughout.

In-window checkout breakdown (18:09:44Z–18:14:44Z): oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder STATUS_CODE_ERROR = 5.0, oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (checkout's client span) STATUS_CODE_ERROR = 5.0, and ERROR = 0 for oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart, oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and oteldemo.CheckoutService/prepareOrderItems; CartService/GetCart, CurrencyService/Convert, ShippingService/GetQuote and ShippingService/ShipOrder carry only STATUS_CODE_UNSET.

Sampled checkout traces show PlaceOrder spans with status error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR, rpc.grpc.status_code=13 and message 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'; sibling client spans oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge in the same traces carry error=true and rpc.grpc.status_code=2. Trace ids: e71c4e626b594762987fa8bb2c3beb1e, 63bd52379ad27ae95253938b75f8686b, cd45afe25ad54a312affc9c80cfbf6b7, 905ef1c8fe5b4d53318e6281e7d8c931, 4b94b3662ecdda9ce4a1f4898cce0ebd, 8fa5b167e684123b02338b824612030c.

Payment service's own span is the origin of the error text: span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (service payment, service_version 2.0.2) has status error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR, grpc.error_message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold', and exception.stacktrace 'Error: Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13)'. Traces: 63bd52379ad27ae95253938b75f8686b, e71c4e626b594762987fa8bb2c3beb1e, 4b94b3662ecdda9ce4a1f4898cce0ebd, 905ef1c8fe5b4d53318e6281e7d8c931, cd45afe25ad54a312affc9c80cfbf6b7. Child spans 'charge' inside payment carry no status (not_recorded).

Payment service metrics confirm its own failure: grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge STATUS_CODE_ERROR = 5.0 and STATUS_CODE_UNSET = 2.5 in the 5-minute window (i.e. about 5 of ~7.5 Charge server spans errored), while internal 'charge' spans and the client span grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat are STATUS_CODE_UNSET.

Payment's Charge errors are new in the last bucket: increase over 300s of traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="payment",span_name="grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"} was 0 at every step 17:19:44Z–18:09:44Z and 5.0 at 18:14:44Z. The earlier comparable baseline window 16:59:44Z–17:04:44Z likewise showed payment STATUS_CODE_ERROR = 0 and checkout STATUS_CODE_ERROR = 0.

No latency elevation against a comparable baseline: p95 of traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds over 300s in the incident window vs 16:59:44Z–17:04:44Z — checkout 45.09 ms vs 47.6 ms, payment 4.7 vs 5.0, cart 3.23 vs 5.17, product-catalog 1.9 vs 1.91, currency 3.4 vs 3.0, shipping 6.9 vs 20.0, email 9.2 vs 30.0.

The other checkout dependencies show no error spans of their own in the window: cart POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart ERROR = 0, product-catalog oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct ERROR = 0, currency Currency/Convert carries STATUS_CODE_OK = 15.0, and shipping (GetQuote, ShipOrder, POST) and email (send_order_confirmation, send_email, sinatra.render_template) return only STATUS_CODE_UNSET series with no ERROR-status series present.

Checkout's clients reach every dependency successfully in the same window: rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count shows status 0 for PaymentService/Charge (1.25), CurrencyService/Convert (17.5), CartService/EmptyCart (1.25), CartService/GetCart (7.5), ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (10.0), ShippingService/GetQuote (7.5) and ShippingService/ShipOrder (1.25), alongside gRPC status 2 for PaymentService/Charge (6.25); the error codes recorded for ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (13) and CartService/EmptyCart (9) are 0.

Failures are also visible one hop outward: frontend POST STATUS_CODE_ERROR = 5.0, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout ERROR = 5.0, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder ERROR = 5.0; frontend-proxy ingress and router frontend egress each ERROR = 5.0 in the same 5-minute window, with zero error spans on the other frontend routes (/api/cart, /api/data, /api/products, /api/recommendations).

Payment service's span names are 'charge', 'grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge' and 'grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat', i.e. payment evaluates a flagd feature flag as part of charging; the flagd resolve client span from payment is STATUS_CODE_UNSET (no error recorded) in the window.

Primary supported cause: the charge-validation path inside the payment service (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37) rejected the request as an invalid token and returned gRPC Unknown, which checkout propagated as code 13 INTERNAL on PlaceOrder. This is the deepest entity with its own failure evidence; confirming whether the rejection is a deliberately activated payment-failure feature flag (the 'app.loyalty.level=gold' suffix and the flagd ResolveFloat span suggest flag-driven behaviour) would require flagd flag configuration or change history.

Secondary unconfirmed candidate: a changed flagd flag value could be the upstream trigger for payment's token rejection, since payment performs grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat and flagd's own resolve spans show no errors. This remains unverified: flagd flag values, evaluation outcomes and payloads are not observable in the available metrics or trace projection, and payment's ResolveFloat span count (1.25 per 5 minutes) is far below its ~7.5 Charge spans, so per-request flag attribution cannot be made.

Rejected: flagd errors as the cause. flagd's only ERROR-status span, flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream, is chronic and sporadic across the whole prior hour — 1.25–2.5 error spans in alternating 5-minute buckets, including buckets where payment Charge STATUS_CODE_ERROR was 0 — so it does not track the payment/checkout error burst that is confined to 18:09:44Z–18:14:44Z.

Rejected: latency saturation in checkout or its dependencies. Whole-window p95 latencies in the incident window are at or below the 16:59:44Z–17:04:44Z baseline for all seven services measured (checkout 45.09 vs 47.6 ms, payment 4.7 vs 5.0, cart 3.23 vs 5.17, product-catalog 1.9 vs 1.91, currency 3.4 vs 3.0, shipping 6.9 vs 20.0, email 9.2 vs 30.0), and the failing payment spans completed in 1.8–4.4 ms.

Rejected: cart, product-catalog, currency, shipping or email as the failing dependency. Their own error signals are absent or zero in the window — cart EmptyCart ERROR = 0, product-catalog GetProduct ERROR = 0, currency Convert STATUS_CODE_OK, shipping and email only STATUS_CODE_UNSET series — and checkout's corresponding client calls carry no error codes (GetProduct 13 = 0, EmptyCart 9 = 0, Convert/GetQuote/ShipOrder status 0), while every observed failure message names the payment charge step.

The payment service was not down or slow: it kept serving Charge successfully in the same window (grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge STATUS_CODE_UNSET = 2.5 success spans, no server-latency increase, checkout's successful PaymentService/Charge client calls at status 0 = 1.25), and sampled traces show fully successful PlaceOrder flows with rpc.grpc.status_code=0 (e.g. trace a7cc6ec526ace8339223f2ede831a555 and f0f055f10938748af3ea8d3a2226ab8f), so the failure is a per-request business rejection rather than a payment outage.

gaps: flagd flag configuration, flag values and change history are not available in this Run (change_history and pod_logs are not integrated), so the trigger for payment's 'Invalid token / app.loyalty.level=gold' rejection cannot be confirmed beyond the payment service handler itself.
Kubernetes object state is not integrated, so restarts or rollouts of payment/checkout around 18:09:44Z–18:14:44Z could not be checked or ruled out.

Trace evidence is a biased sample: the checkout search returned 274 spans across the requested traces (60-row slice read) and the payment search 147 spans (40-row slice read); spans outside those slices, including possible email/product-catalog spans in failed traces, are unknown, and span counts are not unique request counts.
Absence of ERROR-status series for currency, shipping and email is unknown rather than a measured zero; STATUS_CODE_UNSET spans in those services do not prove those calls succeeded.

The exact number of failed customer orders is not directly observable: the ~5 PlaceOrder error spans and ~5 payment Charge error spans per 5 minutes are extrapolated increase() values over spans, with one 5-minute point, and checkout emits more than one span per failed order (server PlaceOrder span plus client Charge span).
next_steps: Inspect flagd's configuration and change records for the payment failure/invalid-token flag affecting app.loyalty.level=gold around 2026-11-03T18:09:44Z, since payment evaluates it via grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat.

Check payment service pod logs/events for /usr/src/app/charge.js:37 rejections near 2026-11-03T18:09:44Z to confirm whether the invalid-token branch is flag-driven or request-data driven (requires pod_logs/kubernetes_state integration).
Re-query the same 5-minute windows after 18:14:44Z to see whether payment Charge STATUS_CODE_ERROR returns to 0 and checkout PlaceOrder errors clear, which would confirm the burst was transient.
report_parsed.summary: Checkout's elevated errors in the last 5 minutes (2026-11-03T18:09:44Z–18:14:44Z) are real and localized: checkout produced ~10 ERROR spans in that bucket while every one of the 11 preceding 5-minute buckets in the prior hour showed 0. The failures are PlaceOrder calls that fail after checkout's client call to oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge; the payment service's own server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge threw 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' at /usr/src/app/charge.js:37 and returned gRPC code 2/Unknown, which checkout surfaced as code 13 INTERNAL 'failed to charge card'. Payment's Charge error rate went from 0 in all prior hourly buckets to ~5 error spans of ~7.5 Charge spans in the window. Cart, product-catalog, currency, shipping and email show no error spans of their own and no ERROR-status series, and no service shows elevated p95 latency versus a comparable baseline window (checkout 45.09 ms now vs 47.6 ms baseline; payment 4.7 vs 5.0; all dependencies at or below baseline). Frontend /api/checkout shows 5 error spans per 5 minutes in the same window, consistent with the checkout failures propagating outward. The deepest cause the evidence supports is payment's own charge validation logic rejecting the request; a flagd feature-flag change is a plausible but unconfirmed upstream trigger.
